owner_request: Propose more Monday1.618 small-timeframe strategies for successive framework tests and explain optimal-parameter search.

authorization.reason: AGENTS.md requires owner confirmation for new thresholds and TP/SL ranges; prepare the complete bounded package first. Existing approved grids are reused.

scope.universe: Reuse registered BTC/ETH, spot XAUUSD and 630-alt universe and historical exclusions. Never select today's winners.
scope.data: Reuse registered original paths and source quality segments; no new downloads or content hashes.
scope.gold: Corrected NY source-clock data only. No volume case; unknown fees remain null. Cost-filter family unavailable.

baselines.rule: Original case1 wick rejection followed immediately by body engulfing; every qualifying event, not restricted to first weekly touch.
First weekly directional pin; volume maximum among previous20 and itself; three following bodies strictly inside; XAU unavailable.
First weekly directional wick-only pin; three following whole candle ranges strictly inside1.618.
First weekly directional wick-only pin; three following open/close bodies at or inside1.618, wicks unrestricted.

frozen_baseline_policy.entry: Next original signal-timeframe open after confirmation; taker.
frozen_baseline_policy.stop: Original pin low for long/high for short.
frozen_baseline_policy.target: Near completed NYMonday edge: Monday low for long/high for short; full limit exit.
frozen_baseline_policy.holding: No expiry, no BE, no partials or trailing, unless that family's one policy is being changed.
frozen_baseline_policy.baseline_choice: Original N3, not the full-period highest-win N5. Freeze before testing exit variants.
frozen_baseline_policy.entry_cohort: Freeze admitted baseline signals for exit/filter studies, including original invalid-entry exclusions. No target change silently adds new entries.

costs.slippage_funding_margin: Not simulated; disclose separately. No funded-account claim.

first_batch.count_definition: Four frozen baselines times (5 TP values +4 reward filters +4 cost filters +5 holding limits). Not trade count. Gold skips inapplicable families/baselines.
first_batch.execution: One family at a time; every family starts from its unchanged baseline. Never carry its winner into the next family.

families.policy: Replace near target with entry + side * value * original pin risk. Keep stop and entry unchanged.
families.implementation_status: Existing execute() accepts explicit target_price; new candidate projection and cache namespace required.

families.name_cn: 过滤目标空间不足的交易
families.policy: At entry decision, admit only when side*(near_target-entry)/original_pin_risk >= threshold. No exit change. Baseline has no filter.
families.engine: Frozen framework ledger subset; no new fill replay
families.implementation_status: Filter only causal entry metadata, never exit or MFE. Retain baseline candidate counts and filtered reasons.

families.name_cn: 过滤手续费吞噬风险的交易
families.policy: At entry admit when original risk >= multiplier*(entry*taker_fee + original_stop*taker_fee), per base unit. Actual fees still use actual fills. Baseline has no filter.
families.engine: Frozen framework ledger subset; no new fill replay
families.implementation_status: Crypto only. A gap can change actual stop fees; never use realized fee to filter entries.

families.name_cn: 止盈止损之外增加持仓时限
families.policy: Keep original near TP/pin SL active before deadline. If still open, market exit at deadline open; not a censor. Deadline is measured from observed baseline entry open.
families.engine: VectorBT native stops plus native deadline order accounting
families.implementation_status: Extend adapter. Existing timed engine has no protective SL, so it cannot be reused unchanged. Define deadline-open priority and same-bar behavior explicitly before execution.

families.policy: Full exit at chosen frozen NYMonday landmark; entry and pin stop unchanged. Midpoint=(MondayHigh+MondayLow)/2.
families.implementation_status: Reuse body60n3 near/far results; midpoint and other signal families require new unique geometries only.

families.policy: Near fraction at near Monday edge; remaining fraction at far edge; original stop unchanged on both legs. Compare ratios against fixed50/50 reference, no BE.
families.engine: Reuse native near/far leg fills and sum actual quantity-weighted fees; framework calculates any missing leg once
families.implementation_status: Existing independent-leg composition reusable. Do not multiply whole-trade fees without actual leg quantities; retain parent censoring.

families.name_cn: 达到浮盈阈值后推含费保本
families.policy: First completed5m close at threshold arms fee-inclusive BE at next5m open; original near TP remains. No partial. Stop already hit before close wins; unfavorable next-open gap cannot be treated as a free BE fill.
families.engine: VectorBT native order callback extension, or predeclared Nautilus native adapter if VBT semantics cannot be aligned; never both replays
families.implementation_status: Current static VBT adapter cannot dynamically amend stops. Must add and validate native order semantics; existing MFE is not an execution simulator.

families.name_cn: 插针止损增加距离缓冲
families.policy: Stop=entry-side*multiplier*original_pin_risk. Entry/near TP unchanged. 1.0 is baseline; larger values only widen the original stop.
families.implementation_status: Reuse explicit stop input; retain original baseline risk R0 and actual new risk as separate columns. No ATR dependency or silent denominator change.

families.policy: After entry, first completed signal-timeframe close beyond1.618 in adverse direction triggers next5m-open market exit. Original resting pin SL and near TP remain active.
families.implementation_status: Extend competing native exit semantics; never use the completed candle's close information at that candle's open.

families.policy: Once original confirmation is complete, rest at frozen1.618 until expiry; original pin SL and near TP. Cancel unfilled order if original stop invalidates setup first. Count unfilled/expired orders explicitly. Compare each TTL against the same market-entry baseline.
families.engine: Extend native pending-limit entry with attached exits; no future-touch entry timestamp fabrication
families.implementation_status: Separate entry-method experiment, not pure exit optimization. Native order priority and OHLC uncertainty require focused tests before historical runs.

analysis.proposed_primary_selection_metric: earlier_mean_net_r0 for crypto; gross_r0 for spot
analysis.r0: Frozen baseline entry-to-pin-stop risk per base unit. All variants retain R0; also report return_bp, actual risk, and R normalized by actual stop risk. Full capital allocation is not modeled.
analysis.selection: Select on earlier segment only, separately by baseline and asset group. Fixed baseline is tie preference, then preregistered candidate order. No later-year tuning.
analysis.evaluation: Later unchanged history, yearly/monthly/direction breakdown; these dates were already researched and are not fresh blind data.
analysis.sample_size: Report counts, uncertainty and censoring. No unapproved minimum-trade filter or hidden deletion of rare/extreme outcomes.
analysis.controls: Same symbol, actual NY entry week, direction and causal volatility bucket; three closed controls per paired signal, identical candidate costs/barriers. For causal filters applied to frozen signal geometry, preserve the corresponding original matched sets and disclose the conditional control population. New entry geometries require new causal matches.
analysis.inference: Reuse weekly-cluster uncertainty method and disclose/correct the predeclared number of comparisons. Absolute profitability and excess over random are separate claims.
analysis.joint_optimization: Not authorized by this proposal. Independent one-factor winners do not establish a joint optimum; interactions would require a separately bounded joint search.

execution_contract.cache_key: Input source identity, quality segment, code/runtime version, entry, side, stop, target, deadline/stop-state policy and fee policy; dynamic semantics must be part of identity.
execution_contract.verification: Synthetic causal/fee/order/edge cases before new historical execution; canonical frozen baseline metrics for reused inputs. No second full framework replay.
before_run: Owner confirms exact new ranges and selection objective
Implement only selected first-batch adapters and meaningful tests
Validate registered source paths, sizes and read access
Record immutable candidate IDs and costs
execution_contract.delivery: Conversation plus all-candidate and all-trade raw files; add results to the already requested HTML when its Stitch blocker clears. No separate unsolicited report.
